summary: LTP on an NSE equity and on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX 26000 on segment 1): each subscribe is one REST call with code 1512, each 1512 event becomes an LTP frame with the trade time in Unix milliseconds, and after the unsubscribe (a PUT) a late event reaches nobody.

notes: XTS LastTradedTime counts seconds from 1980-01-01 IST; the desktop sends it as Unix milliseconds (families/xts/streaming.rs xts_time_ms).
One instrument per subscribe, so each REST body names one instrument (the feed batches what arrives together).

deviations.reason: The web's XTS LTP data carries the last traded quantity as ltq; the desktop's LTP frames carry no last quantity (audit C06 carrier, lane wire).

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
